title: BAT3R: Robust Online 3D Reconstruction with Bayesian Adaptive State Updates
abstract: arXiv:2610.16330v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Feed-forward transformer models have driven remarkable progress in 3D vision,yet their quadratic complexity renders them impractical for long video sequences. Streaming 3D reconstruction addresses this bottleneck by processing frames sequen?tially with constant memory. However, existing recurrent architectures inevitably suffer from progressive degradation over long sequences, as they fail to account for the intrinsic reliability of observations and the accumulated confidence of the historical state, leading to severe error accumulation. To address these issues, we introduce BAT3R, a training-free Bayesian adaptation framework comprising two synergistic modules: State Innovation Gating (SIG) and Bayesian-guided Adaptive State Updating (BASU). translated_title: BAT3R：基于贝叶斯自适应状态更新的鲁棒在线三维重建
translated_abstract: 前馈Transformer模型在三维视觉领域取得了显著进展，但其二次方复杂度使其难以应用于长视频序列。流式三维重建通过以恒定内存按顺序处理帧来解决这一瓶颈。然而，现有的循环架构在长序列上不可避免地会出现渐进式性能退化，因为它们未能考虑观测数据的内在可靠性以及历史状态累积的置信度，从而导致严重的误差累积。为解决这些问题，我们提出了BAT3R，一个无需训练的贝叶斯自适应框架，包含两个协同工作的模块：状态创新门控（SIG）和贝叶斯引导的自适应状态更新（BASU）。SIG作为一种分布正则化器，将状态演化锚定于其几何初始化，有效抑制了长期推理过程中的表征漂移。在此基础上，BA（摘要不完整，原文在此处截断）
tldr: BAT3R提出了一种无需训练的贝叶斯自适应框架，通过状态创新门控（SIG）和贝叶斯引导的自适应状态更新（BASU）两个模块，综合考虑观测可靠性与历史状态置信度，有效解决了流式三维重建在长序列上的误差累积与表征漂移问题。
en_tdlr: BAT3R introduces a training-free Bayesian adaptation framework with two synergistic modules—State Innovation Gating (SIG) and Bayesian-guided Adaptive State Updating (BASU)—that account for observation reliability and accumulated state confidence to mitigate error accumulation and representational drift in streaming 3D reconstruction over long sequences.
